CPUChecks: Actual BufferSubData: fresh/no upload, zero-byte call, two partial uploads then one invalidation, repeat invalidation, next-frame upload, owned CPU memory/client pointer, both usage hints, Resize before/after upload; preserve ID/byteSize/offsets and reset marker only when appropriate. In unsupported/HEADLESS mode, a frame-boundary call clears only the marker; consecutive no-upload frames issue no GL work.
Use nonzero foreign VAO with a different EBO, nonzero COPY_WRITE binding, ARRAY_BUFFER and indexed SSBO state. DSA and fallback must preserve all of them. DSA should record no state query/bind calls.

Feature matrix: core4.5+named pointer and ARB DSA+pointer; null pointer or unsupported DSA flags may use COPY_WRITE only with core3.1 or ARB_copy_buffer. GL3.0 with neither capability, including non-null unsupported named pointer, must issue no GL call and preserve bytes/state. HEADLESS compiles/links without the new DSA pointer/ARB DSA variable and performs no orphan GL calls.
Run the external target Bind/Unbind body only as a fixture negative control; the VAO assertion must reject it. No unsafe body goes into product sources.

Actual Typed Swap/Clear/upload: fresh object, non-indexed/indexed buffers, upload/no-upload frames, readonly, CopyCurrent readonly and writable independent copies, move ownership, and offset-zero reupload after frame reset.

Lobby only: actual GetPendingElemsRange/DrawElementsRange redraw before Swap yields the same queued geometry and does not invalidate early. Chobby uses its existing indexed draw API; do not add the missing range API.

Model uploader regression: reuse only sparse/fallback/idle examples from existing CheckSparseSnapshotMaps/CheckUniformRing selections. General Swap produces zero orphan calls and retains unchanged indexed bytes; persistent paths remain no-op Invalidate.
Retain old-generation reads across the frame boundary and consume them after fresh-generation upload; distinguish this CPU model from proof of actual GPU behavior.

CPUExecutionPlan.lanes: Both source roots, interactive feature matrix and a HEADLESS compatibility variant; use existing ASan/UBSan flags and bounded cases.
CPUExecutionPlan.resultAccounting: Record changed-path assertions, extracted source hashes and failures. No FPS or GPU guarantee from mock results. Do not rerun unrelated concurrency suites.

laterRealGL.cases: Query actual context version/ARB DSA support and loaded named pointer, preserve foreign VAO/EBO/COPY_WRITE state around storage replacement, and check indexed/nonindexed output plus same-frame reuse and post-orphan reupload. Use the chosen candidate's packaged stack.
laterRealGL.gate: No GPU/context/app execution during the current R/Small comparison. Actual later execution requires the source/build/runtime handoff.
laterRealGL.limits: These API/component controls do not execute Recoil's full game path. Actual Typed C++ behavior is covered by the CPU source-path fixture; later private BAR.app acceptance remains separate and root-owned.
laterRealGL.reuse: tools/probe-run75-vbo-vao.py already supplies pinned EGL/Zink context, finite indexed/nonindexed drawing, state queries and readback. Reuse its context and add a bounded case selection; do not run its full MSAA/instancing matrix for this change.

packageAndAcceptance.performance: Root chooses bounded fair comparison after functionality/packaging. Assess frame time and any meaningful memory regression; no premature FPS promise or instrumentation project.
packageAndAcceptance.replace: Exactly the two selected-parent engine executables plus required signing records; never copy active raw MVK.
packageAndAcceptance.verify: Parent inventory unchanged; candidate runtime/MVK, launcher code, Lua/NoGS/healthbar assets exact; engine version identity, closure and strict signature valid.

reuse.actualCode: Use actual StreamBuffer.h/cpp and actual TypedRenderBuffer methods. Prefer the actual RenderBuffers.h; if shader/link dependencies are excessive, extract exact class/method bodies with source hashes and mock only unrelated shader/VAO receivers. Do not substitute a hand-written Typed algorithm.
reuse.approach: Add a bounded frame-local-orphan selection to the existing runner/fixture after implementation grant. Retain --source-root so each lane is checked. Avoid invoking unrelated list, Lua, producer-publication or thread suites.
reuse.backingModel: Track buffer object separately from storage generation. Issued reads retain the old generation; orphan creates poisoned fresh bytes. New writes must not mutate old queued reads. Keep persistent-storage fence semantics from the existing fixture.
reuse.fakeGLDefect: The existing single global bound ignores target/VAO and cannot detect EBO damage. Extend only the selected test mode to target-specific bindings, current VAO and per-VAO element attachment.

scope: 11a changed stream/Typed paths only; no global audit, new production collector or broad benchmark suite

syntaxAndBuild.identity: Before and after, compare official version and numeric/sync policy plus immutable provider source pins. Version-only checks later use the private workspace, not a user profile.
syntaxAndBuild.incremental: After independent proposal review and explicit grant, apply exact current-mtime hunks, verify both CMake caches unchanged, then build existing engine-legacy targets in both active build roots. Record dependent TU recompilation; no clean/configure/whole-stack rebuild.
syntaxAndBuild.syntax: Use each existing compile configuration for changed-header consumers StreamBuffer.cpp and glFontRenderer.cpp. Verify HEADLESS symbol exclusion through the bounded fixture/link check.
